The background is a blurred outdoor scene with green foliage. A large, semi-transparent watermark reading 'FOTOLIA' and 'Marek Uliasz' overlays the center of the image.

The fabric around the shoulders and chest is loose and does not cling to the body, consistent with the voluminous nature of an academic gown.
